settings.question: Can I add a personal message?
settings.answer: Yes. Every combo includes a personalised Diwali card. Write your message at checkout and we'll print it for you.

settings.question: Can I choose the bookmark designs?
settings.answer: Yes. Pick their fandom, from Harry Potter and anime to Disney and coquette, when you choose the combo.

settings.question: How does the AR photo frame work?
settings.answer: Point an iPhone camera at the frame and your video plays. On Android, scan it with our free app.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: Pay online with UPI, cards or netbanking. Prepaid orders ship free.

settings.heading: This Diwali, give them a memory, not just a gift
settings.subheading: Sweets get eaten. Lights come down. A gift with their name, their story or your voice stays long after the last diya goes out.
settings.truth_line: We live in a world where we capture everything but remember nothing.
settings.truth_text: Thousands of photos sit in our phones, unseen. So we make small things you can hold, keep and come back to: their name on a notepad, their fandom in a bookmark, your video inside a frame.
settings.moments_heading: Who's on your list this Diwali?
settings.moments_subheading: Start with the person, not the product. Even if that person is you.
settings.boxes_heading: Diwali combos, made to feel personal
settings.boxes_subheading: For the people you love, and one for you. Every combo comes with a free personalised Diwali card and a free sticker set.
settings.band_heading: Say the thing you never say out loud
settings.band_text: Every combo includes a personalised Diwali card. Write the thank-you, the sorry or the I-miss-you. We'll make sure it arrives looking as special as it feels.
settings.reviews_heading: What people felt when they opened it
settings.closing_line: Happy Diwali from Luxe Magics. May every memory stay bright.
